banner: Developer demo: components driven by synthetic inputs generated in the browser, not device data.

schemaForm.title: SchemaForm demo
schemaForm.emptyHint: This generated schema has no fields yet (its P02 group has not merged into main); the renderer shows its passthrough object as a key/JSON editor.

problem.title: Validation failed
problem.detail: Simulated by the demo page (no server involved).
problem.mtu: Simulated: MTU exceeds the parent interface MTU
problem.vlan: Simulated: VLAN already in use on this parent
problem.unmapped: Simulated pointer that matches no field

dataGrid.title: ServerDataGrid demo
dataGrid.body: {{count}} synthetic rows are generated in the browser; a local fetchPage pages, sorts and filters them with the same contract the API will use (paginationMode/sortingMode/filterMode = server).

stream.title: WebSocket stream demo
stream.body: One multiplexed connection to /api/v1/stream, opened only while a topic has subscribers. Without vrx-api (P06) the client stays in the reconnecting state with exponential backoff; that is the real state, not simulated data.

kitPreview.title: Config kit preview
kitPreview.intro: Widgets of the config screen kit with synthetic values. Nothing on this page talks to the device.
kitPreview.itemBody: A drawer opened from the key button. Keyboard: Tab or the arrow keys to the key cell, then Enter or Space.
